name: Advanced Filesystem: Archive
description: Multi-file ZIP download, upload extraction (create managed File entities from ZIP contents), and in-archive browse without extraction.
project_description: Advanced Filesystem: Archive is a submodule of Advanced FileSystem that adds three ZIP capabilities to Drupal's managed-file system: streaming a bundle of selected managed files to the browser as a single ZIP (built with PHP ZipArchive to a temp file, then streamed with fpassthru, and logged to adfs_archive_downloads); extracting an uploaded ZIP so each contained file becomes its own Drupal-managed File entity (with MIME filtering, a per-file size cap, filename sanitisation and extraction lineage recorded in adfs_archive_extractions); and browsing the file listing inside a ZIP without extracting anything. Each capability is gated behind its own permission, and limits (max files per download, max ZIP size, max extracted file size, default extraction scheme/subdirectory) are configurable at admin/config/media/advanced_filesystem/archive.
